provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: exclusive policy-capable CNI lease with paired clients

cases.task: Read the selected Pod label and policy direction.
Combine the deny-ingress and allow-client policies.
cases.expected: The explicit matching allow remains effective;there is no ordered deny override.

cases.task: Compare one peer containing namespace+Pod selectors with two separate peers.
cases.expected: One peer means conjunction;separate entries mean alternatives.

cases.task: Observe both approved clients against a healthy backend before enforcement.
cases.expected: Both paths succeed with the expected payload and target receipt.

cases.task: Repeat both paths after the reviewed policies in a qualified CNI lease.
cases.expected: Permitted path succeeds;other path fails within its deadline.

cases.task: Record exact policy/client UIDs and the scope of the isolation claim.
cases.expected: Only owned policy resources are cleaned;protocols,hosts and capabilities outside the test remain unclaimed.
